Subject: Email practices

Dear John,

I hope you’re doing well. I’d like to take a moment to share a quick reminder about effective email practices and request your assistance with a small but important task.

When sending emails, it’s crucial to use a clear subject line that reflects the purpose of your message, keep your wording concise, and maintain a polite, professional tone. Additionally, always proofread your email for accuracy and ensure all necessary attachments are included before sending to avoid any confusion.

As part of improving our communication process, I kindly ask you to connect with the PR manager to verify your details and ensure everything is up to date
